top_signals.title: Asia Stocks Sell Off As AI Rout Deepens
top_signals.summary: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Queensland, New Zealand and Hong Kong with Haidi Stroud-Watts and Annabelle Droulers, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
